summary: our game was created with the goal of reaching earth through space before a meteor strikes it.
details: we used gemini as our artificial intelligence while doing these things.We designed a space station game.Our game features speed-boost and shield power-ups,well as meteors,poisonous potatoes,and coins. once 30,000 coins are collected, the game ends;at the very end, we astronauts step out of the space shuttle, and people celebrate us.
